subject: maths
question:
A total of ₹2,00,000 is divided into two parts for investing in different banks on simple interest. One yields 4% p.a. while the

other yields 6% p.a. If the total interest at the end of one year is equivalent to 4.7% p.a. on the whole amount, the amount (in

₹) invested in each bank is ________, respectively.
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

By using the mixture and alligation rule directly on the interest rates:

Ratio of investments = (6% − 4.7%) : (4.7% − 4%) = 1.3 : 0.7 = 13 : 7

Total parts = 13 + 7 = 20 parts ≡ ₹2,00,000

Amount in 4% bank (13 parts) = (13 ÷ 20) × 2,00,000 = ₹1,30,000

Amount in 6% bank (7 parts) = (7 ÷ 20) × 2,00,000 = ₹70,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,30,000 and ₹70,000.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total principal = ₹2,00,000

Interest rate of Bank 1 = 4% p.a.

Interest rate of Bank 2 = 6% p.a.

Overall equivalent rate = 4.7% p.a. for 1 year

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5ccea50f1a263967c2a5efa52594c3a5bf6fa5704ac4a02a49ef7beb0c13f6fd.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total interest earned at 4.7% = (2,00,000 × 4.7 × 1) ÷ 100 = ₹9,400

⇒ Let the principal invested in Bank 1 be ₹x. Thus, the principal in Bank 2 will be ₹(2,00,000 − x).

⇒ Total Interest = Interest from Bank 1 + Interest from Bank 2

⇒ [(x × 4 × 1) ÷ 100] + [((2,00,000 − x) × 6 × 1) ÷ 100] = 9400

⇒ 4x + 12,00,000 − 6x = 9,40,000

⇒ 2x = 12,00,000 − 9,40,000

⇒ 2x = 2,60,000

⇒ x = ₹1,30,000

⇒ Investment in Bank 2 = 2,00,000 − 1,30,000 = ₹70,000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹1,30,000 and ₹70,000.**

**__Additional Information__**

Mixtures and Alligations

It is an analytical method used to find the ratio in which two quantities must be mixed to obtain a desired average value. Rule: (Quantity of Cheaper) ÷ (Quantity of Dearer) = (Price of Dearer − Average Price) ÷ (Average Price − Price of Cheaper).

Simple Interest (SI)

It is the interest calculated only on the original principal amount. The principal remains constant throughout the tenure. Formula: SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100.

Overall / Effective Interest Rate

When multiple investments are made at different interest rates, the overall interest rate is the weighted average of the individual rates based on the amount of capital invested in each scheme.
